risks.if_unproven: priced as empty cases with no discs

risks.risk: Discs may be scratched, cracked, or damaged
risks.proof: Close-up photo or clip of the disc surfaces
risks.if_unproven: priced as damaged or unreadable discs

risks.risk: Cases may be cracked, chipped, or broken
risks.proof: Close-up photos of case edges, corners, and spines from multiple angles

Provide close-up photos of the disc surfaces
Provide close-up photos of case edges and corners
Show any booklets or download codes inside the cases

response.reason: The witness identifies the items as PS5 physical game cases, so they can be priced at their worst case; the seller's PS4 claim is contradicted by the visible PS5 branding.
